sourceText: Maelfu ya miaka iliyopita, mwanamume aliyeitwa Aristarchus alisema kwamba Mfumo wa Jua ulizunguka Jua.
referenceText: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
